Initial release of Photo Video Maker en Español — Turn your photos into shareable videos in Spanish.

- Create slideshow videos from JPG, PNG, HEIC, or WebP photos (up to 200MB total).
- Offers Spanish-language prompts and workflows for social media users.
- Automatic session creation, free anonymous authentication, and 7-day token validity.
- AI cloud backend delivers 1080p MP4 video exports in 30–60 seconds.
- Built-in error handling for uploads, file type, credits, and plan status.
- Workflow support for editing, layering audio/text, and exporting for WhatsApp/Instagram/YouTube.
